verdict.rationale: Capacities documents `[[]]` (and `@`) linking to existing content, and collects all backlinks in a dedicated "Backlinks" section at the bottom of each object, so the wiki-link and backlink core of the story is delivered. Nothing in the pack shows unlinked-mention detection, and nothing confirms backlinks appear with surrounding context rather than as a list. missing for 10: unlinked mentions, evidence that backlinks are shown in context, independent or hands-on corroboration.
